mentions.name: MonoHub
mentions.description: An EU-based, EU-hosted and developed GitHub alternative that began as a slim wrapper around Git to serve the author's own code. It currently offers a file browser and a pull request review tool with basic PR support, treats accessibility as a high priority, and is being offered as a paid service (free for contributors) with an early adopter discount.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://monohub.dev — a new EU-based (hosted and developed) GitHub alternative. Currently, it has a file browser and a PR review tool. Started off as a personal tool, but grew enough to consider offering as a service.
